downloads.note: This repository is the Qoder plugin only. Per-plugin zips, when a release exists, are named qoder_{version}_{goos}_{goarch}.zip and are resolved from the plugin repository field. There is no five-plugin bundle.

plugins.name: Qoder
plugins.description: Qoder unified provider for CPA (merged v0.10.0): CN (auth qoder.cn, API openapi.qoder.com.cn / gateway.qoder.com.cn) and Intl (qoder.com / openapi.qoder.sh) in one plugin id qoder, per-account region routing, device-flow + PAT login, COSY-signed chat, campaign check-in, Pro upgrade claim, token keepalive, auto-adopts legacy qoder-cn / qoder-intl auth files. qoder.com.cn is the legacy IDE host.
plugins.author: mmqz
plugins.changelog: auth.parse now carries the operator fields (proxy_url/prefix/priority...) back to the host, so the panel proxy no longer resets to none after restarts or plugin rewrites (issue #68).
